versions.changelog: Refresh Jev native System One integration and direct self-hosted /docs links from the validated canonical skill source; preserve contract-driven model selection and reversible client setup.

Initial release: provides streamlined, runnable integration examples for TokenLab APIs.

- Delivers minimal runnable code examples for TokenLab chat, image, audio, video, and other API families.
- Specifies required base URLs, authentication, install commands, and environment variables.
- Includes clear model discovery instructions and public contract checks before hardcoding model or request details.
- Introduces an agent-first recovery path for handling route/model errors.
- Explains when to follow OpenAI compatibility vs. use native Anthropic or Gemini routes.
- Emphasizes concrete outputs and avoids pseudocode or incomplete examples.
